content.text: Angular is Google's TypeScript-based component framework for building enterprise-scale single-page applications with dependency injection, RxJS, and a comprehensive CLI toolchain.

items: Angular Overview — Components, services, dependency injection, routing, RxJS, and enterprise patterns
Components & Templates — Lifecycle hooks, change detection, content projection, directives, pipes, and standalone components
Services & Dependency Injection — Hierarchical injectors, providers, HttpClient, interceptors, and RxJS state management
Routing & Modules — Lazy loading, route guards, preloading strategies, NgModules vs standalone architecture
RxJS & Reactive Patterns — Observables, operators, Subjects, async pipe, error handling, and real-time data streams
